Name: Community Warmth  - Winter Heaters for Villagers
Author: logNest
Description:
[heading][font=Arial]Community Warmth 冬日温暖[/font][/heading]
[font=Arial][size=3][b]Supported languages: [/b]English, 简体中文[/size][/font]

[font=Arial]你是否想过冬天的星露谷很冷，而有些村民家中看起来很需要一台取暖器？[/font]
[font=Arial]本mod让原版加热器有了新的用途。放入支持的npc家中，让居民感受到温暖。这个举动会增加npc好感，并给你寄来一封感谢信。[/font]
[heading][size=4][font=Arial]使用方法[/font][/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*][font=Arial]在玛妮的牧场购买一台 取暖器（ 加热器 ）。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]将它放进支持的 NPC 家中。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]睡到第二天。 [/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]住在该地点的 NPC 会增加80点好感。 [/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]对方发现取暖器后，会给你寄来感谢信和礼物。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]右键 / 交互取暖器，可以查看它是否正在工作。 [/font][/*]
[/list][heading][size=4][font=Arial]当前支持住户[/font][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Arial]莱纳斯[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]莉亚[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]潘姆和潘妮[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]艾利欧特[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]威利[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]雷欧（鹈鹕镇树屋）[/font][/*]
[/list][heading][size=4][font=Arial]说明[/font][/size][/heading]
[list]
[*][font=Arial]本 mod 没有添加新机器，只是为原版加热器添加了新功能。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]加热器需要避开 NPC 行动路径摆放。[/font][/*]
[*][font=Arial]NPC 必须先被玩家认识，mod 才能成功增加好感。如果某个 NPC 仍然显示为“???”，需要先和他们互动一次。[/font][/*]
[/list][size=4][font=Arial][b]English：[/b][/font][/size]
Have you ever felt that winter in Stardew Valley is a little too cold — and that some villagers’ homes look like they could really use a heater?
This mod gives the vanilla [b]Heater[/b] a new purpose.
Place a heater inside a supported NPC home to bring a little warmth to the people living there. This kind gesture will increase their friendship with you, and they will send you a thank-you letter in return.
[heading][size=4]How to use[/size][/heading]
[list=1]
[*]Buy a [b]Heater[/b] from Marnie’s Ranch. [/*]
[*]Place it inside a supported NPC home. [/*]
[*]Sleep until the next day. [/*]
[*]The NPCs living in that location will gain [b]80 friendship points[/b]. [/*]
[*]After noticing the heater, they will send you a thank-you letter with a gift. [/*]
[*]Right-click / interact with the heater to check whether it is working. [/*]
[/list][heading][size=4]Currently supported households[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]Linus[/*]
[*]Leah[/*]
[*]Pam and Penny[/*]
[*]Elliott[/*]
[*]Willy[/*]
[*]Leo (treehouse in Stardew Valley)[/*]
[/list][heading][size=4]Notes[/size][/heading]
[list]
[*]This mod does [b]NOT[/b] add a new machine. It adds new features to the original Heater. [/*]
[*]The heater should be placed somewhere that does not block NPC walking paths. [/*]
[*]A character must be known to the player before the mod can increase their friendship.  If an NPC still appears as “???” in the social tab, talk to them once first.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Name: Community Warmth
Manifest.Description: Place vanilla heaters in villager homes during winter to share a little warmth.
Manifest.Author: logNest
